result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 1 (General Provisions), covering code enforcement authority, judicial remedies and administrative hearing procedures, retrieved from a page nominally about the algorithmic rent-setting prohibition.
result.notes: This part of the document contains only general code enforcement provisions (Sec. 11.0402 through 12.0402): enforcement authority, notices of violation, criminal and civil penalties, abatement and hearing procedures. It contains no rule on rent increases, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions or algorithmic rent setting. The page URL refers to Division 11 (Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price Fixing), Sec. 98.1103, but that text does not appear in this part, so no algorithmic_rent_setting rule can be extracted from it.
